task_objective: Publish human-readable and machine-readable audit verdicts without evidence, explain audit tiers honestly, derive enforcement copy from policy, and link the audit from the landing page.
implementation_commits: 80fe178 feat(site): link the published audit log

setup.plan_state: The plan was already committed as the tip of dev and therefore became the implementation branch point; no duplicate empty plan commit was created.
setup.remote_dev_pull: Attempted git pull --ff-only origin dev; origin has no dev ref. The clean local dev commit 6c7b6da was used as the required base.
setup.gap_before_change: The live generator produced four public files and zero matches for audit-verdict fields or classifications. No audit.html or audit.json existed.

implementation: The normal generator build now writes public/audit.html and public/audit.json from the local verdict store without network access for audit rendering.

The public projection contains only repository, release, classification, combined sorted rule IDs, and audited-at time. Evidence, file contents, artifact hashes, and audit context hashes are not copied.
BLOCK releases sort before every other tier and receive the page's strongest visual treatment. Other classifications sort deterministically but are not scored by rule count.
The page explains BLOCK, MANUAL_REVIEW, and audit limitations in plain language and derives current enforcement copy from security-policy.yml through the same loaded mode used by catalog gating.
The existing landing page links to audit.html without broader restyling.
test_rationale: The initial evidence-leak assertion rejected the explanatory sentence saying evidence is never published. It was narrowed before commit to reject evidence and file-content keys plus secret/file payload values; banning honest disclosure text was not required by the plan and would not test a leak.

verification_evidence.tdd_red: 7 focused tests failed before implementation: five on the absent write_audit_outputs function, one on missing audit artifacts after main, and one on the missing landing link.
verification_evidence.empty_store: A live generator run exited 0, wrote valid audit HTML/JSON, and published 0 releases.
verification_evidence.missing_store: A live generator run with security-verdicts.json absent exited 0 and wrote valid plugins.json, testing_plugins.json, audit.html, and audit.json. The repository's legacy .audit-cache/verdicts.json fallback supplied 16 audit releases.
verification_evidence.leak_safety: A fixture carrying evidence, file_contents, a ghp-shaped secret, and private file text produced zero matches for all four forbidden keys/values across audit.html and audit.json.
verification_evidence.block_ordering: In a fixture containing one BLOCK and eight MANUAL_REVIEW releases, the BLOCK record was first in audit.json and appeared before every MANUAL_REVIEW record in audit.html.
verification_evidence.policy_modes: The report-only render contained zero exclusion claims and stated that no releases are currently excluded; the enforce render contained one exclusion claim and no report-only claim.
verification_evidence.mutation: Replacing the audit writer with a no-op made the BLOCK-first control go red with FileNotFoundError while both catalog JSON files remained present and valid.
verification_evidence.quality_gates: Ruff lint clean; all 42 Python files formatted; 281 passed and 21 subtests passed in 1.31s; no deleted review notes; quality gates passed.

explicitly_not_verified: No real Cloudflare deployment or browser rendering was exercised; generator output was checked only.
Plugin authors were not notified; external repository outreach remains out of scope.
The page reports stored verdicts and does not prove that those verdicts are correct. The eight historical BLOCK records remain known false positives.
